auxiliary_results.name: decic_C226_reduction_to_two_rational_divisor_classes
auxiliary_results.statement: Every decic C2 x C26 trace divisor, modulo level automorphisms, belongs to one of two explicit rational classes; the degree-nine-plus-cusp branch is excluded. Effectivity and the two representatives are determined in complete_decic_C226_case.

auxiliary_results.name: complete_decic_C226_case
auxiliary_results.statement: Both residual rational classes have h0=1 and a unique irreducible noncuspidal degree-ten representative. Exactly two Galois and level orbits occur, each with full torsion C2 x C26 and quintic j-invariant. No dual 2-isogeny kernel can be halved over either field.

auxiliary_results.name: decic_C232_quotient_rigidity
auxiliary_results.statement: X1(2,32) has Q-gonality at least 12. Its unique remaining reduction orbit descends to a quintic divisor on the genus-13 quotient. The rational Jacobian modulo rational cuspidal classes has order at most two; the identity and diamond-3 cusp-complement coset sets are disjoint. C2 x C32 and C64 are excluded.

auxiliary_results.name: decic_C234_cuspidal_pencil_obstruction
auxiliary_results.statement: All 521 noncuspidal degree-ten support patterns are excluded. The full rational cusp unit lattice has no vector of squared norm <=60, which proves Q-gonality at least11 and closes entirely cuspidal reduction.

auxiliary_results.name: decic_C236_cuspidal_pencil_and_orbit_section_obstruction
auxiliary_results.statement: The finite filters reduce 135282 degree-ten noncuspidal support patterns to a single degree-eight support. All degree-two cusp complements are excluded using the unramified order-four quotient and 23 exact character Riemann-Roch tests. The full Frobenius-fixed principal cusp lattice has no degree-ten positive part within squared norm 104; this proves rational gonality at least 11 and closes entirely cuspidal reduction. C2 x C36 and C72 are excluded.

auxiliary_results.name: decic_dyadic_cuspidal_diamond_criterion_95_111
auxiliary_results.statement: All reductions are cuspidal; rational cusp lifts allow a finite diamond difference. The dyadic torsion kernel has exponent two, giving a degree40 comparison below gonality. Diamond invariance of order3 contradicts degree10.

auxiliary_results.name: decic_C49_Cartier_formal_immersion
auxiliary_results.statement: All degree9 and degree10 noncuspidal reduction orbits fail A3. Rational-cusp reduction is excluded by torsion injectivity. Mixed cusp reductions have Cartier-image restriction rank10 in all2900895 checked cases. The full-Jacobian dyadic kernel lemma over Q2 gives formal immersion without a quotient cotangent exact sequence. Completed subcalculations of unsuccessful runs are isolated and independently validated; no unsuccessful whole computation is a completed certificate.

auxiliary_results.name: decic_C51_dyadic_Cartier_exclusion
auxiliary_results.statement: All nine noncuspidal reduction orbits have nonprincipal A5 image. Exact common-basis and fresh native jets verify rank10 for all9656144 cusp divisors. A one-dimensional Cartier-intertwiner space with the order-eight cusp kernel identifies bases up to a diamond. The full-Jacobian Q2 formal-immersion criterion excludes every proposed divisor.
